{{Quote|Supreme Chancellor, we appreciate that you elected to appear before us, without being subpoenaed by writ.|Unidentified Chief Justice|<ref name="CoD" />}}
A '''Supreme Court inquiry''' was launched<ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]]<ref name="TNEC" /> into allegations of embezzlement by [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], then [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Chancellor was suspected of having accepted an enormous sum in [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] [[ingot]]s in exchange for a secret partnership with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. During the inquiry, the prosecution was represented by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] and [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of the [[Internal Activities Committee/Legends|Internal Activities Committee]]. The case was heard by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Unidentified Chief Justice|Chief Justice]] and eleven other members of the judiciary council, while Valorum was represented by a team of [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyers]] with an assigned [[Finis Valorum's lawyer|spokesperson]].<ref name="CoD" />
